department: Faculty 7 - Engineering Design, Production Engineering and Automotive Engineering (individual doctorate); GSaME for the structured route

deadline.value: GSaME advertises open research topics continuously and processes applications on submission; check its current deadlines.
deadline.quote: Open research topics are advertised continuously by GSaME.

gre_subject.value: The Faculty 7 and GSaME pages do not mention a GRE Subject test.

supervisor.value: A supervising professor from the faculty doctoral committee, and a signed agreement, are needed.
supervisor.quote: Together with your supervisor, you will draw up an agreement on doctoral studies including the required qualification program

funding.value: Most doctoral candidates at Stuttgart already hold a paid doctoral job; this is a university-wide statement.
funding.quote: Most individual doctoral degree candidates at the University of Stuttgart already have a paid doctoral student job and work as research assistants for the University.

entry_route.value: A master's degree in the field of the research topic is required for GSaME; the faculty route follows the doctoral regulations.
entry_route.quote: A Master’s or equivalent university degree in the field of the research topic

toefl_min.value: GSaME asks for English C1, equivalent to 94 or more on the internet-based TOEFL.
toefl_min.quote: corresponds to 94 or more points in the Internet-Based TOEFL test (iBT-TOEFL)

ielts_min.value: GSaME asks for English C1, such as IELTS 7.0 or higher. Individual faculty doctorates state no English rule.
ielts_min.quote: Language certificates of English language proficiency (at least Level C1, e.g. proven by IELTS 7.0 or higher

notes: Two routes: the individual Faculty 7 doctorate and the GSaME graduate school. The English overrides come from the GSaME page only. Faculty 6 (Aerospace Engineering) has a PhD page with links only and no admission rule, so no aerospace-specific values are saved.
